decision.rationale: This dispute was opened in time but is declined under the chip-and-PIN rule. TXN-007870 (58.02 EUR, OAKHOLLOW CHEMIST) posted on 2026-08-21. The dispute was opened on 2026-10-28, 68 days later, which is inside the 120-day limit in time-limits. Its authorisation AUTH-008082 shows entry mode CHIP, PIN verified true, fraud flag false and response APPROVED. That means the card and the correct PIN were used at the merchant's terminal. The card has also made earlier purchases at the same merchant: TXN-007869 on 2026-07-17 and TXN-007868 on 2026-07-10. Under unauthorised-chip-and-pin, a chip transaction with the PIN verified and no fraud flag is treated as made by the cardholder and is declined. The cardholder's statement that they do not recognise the payment does not outweigh the authorisation record.

proposed_actions.reason: The payment of 58.02 EUR to OAKHOLLOW CHEMIST on 2026-08-20 was made with your card's chip, and your PIN was entered correctly at the shop's terminal. Our fraud checks did not flag it. Your card has also been used at this merchant before. Under our policy, a chip-and-PIN payment like this counts as made by the cardholder, so we cannot treat it as unauthorised.
